en.s: The third Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place on 27 August 1105 between the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimids of Egypt. The town of Ramla lay on the road from Jerusalem to Ascalon, the latter of which was the largest Fatimid fortress in Palestine. From Ascalon the Fatimid vizier, Al-Afdal Shahanshah, launched almost annual attacks into the newly founded Crusader kingdom from 1099 to 1107. Of the three battles the Crusaders fought at Ramla early in the twelfth century, the third was the most bloody. Egyptian armies of the period relied on masses of Sudanese bowmen supported by Arab and Berber cavalry.

zh.s: 1105年8月27日，耶路撒冷十字军王国与埃及法蒂玛王朝在拉姆拉交战。拉姆拉位于耶路撒冷通往阿斯卡隆的道路上；阿斯卡隆是法蒂玛王朝在巴勒斯坦最大的堡垒。1099年至1107年间，法蒂玛大臣阿夫达勒·沙汉沙赫几乎每年都从阿斯卡隆向新建立的十字军王国发动进攻。十字军在12世纪初于拉姆拉打过三场战役，第三次伤亡最惨重。当时的埃及军队依靠大量苏丹弓箭手，并由阿拉伯和柏柏尔骑兵支援。

en.s: The Battle of Alghero or Porto Conte was fought on 27 August 1353 at the Bay of Porto Conte, just off the town of Alghero in northwestern Sardinia, between the fleet of the Republic of Genoa and the allied fleet of the Crown of Aragon and the Republic of Venice. The battle was part of the War of the Straits between Genoa and Venice, as well as the Sardinian–Aragonese war, in which Genoa backed Sardinian rebels against Aragonese rule.

zh.s: 1353年8月27日，热那亚共和国舰队与阿拉贡王冠和威尼斯共和国的联军舰队在撒丁岛西北部阿尔盖罗镇外的波尔图孔特湾交战。这场战役也称波尔图孔特海战，是热那亚与威尼斯之间海峡战争的一部分，也属于撒丁—阿拉贡战争；在后者中，热那亚支持撒丁叛军反抗阿拉贡统治。

en.s: The Crusade of Tedelis was a major conflict within the overarching struggle between the Crown of Aragon and the Kingdom of Tlemcen in the late 14th century.

zh.s: 特德利斯十字军东征是14世纪末阿拉贡王国与特莱姆森王国长期冲突中的一场重大交战。

en.s: The Battle of the Siritsa River (also Seritsa) took place on 27 August 1501 between the forces of the Livonian Order under Grand Master Wolter von Plettenberg on the one side and the forces of the Grand Duchy of Moscow and Pskov Republic on the other. The Russian forces were soundly defeated. Grand Prince Ivan III of Russia pursued expansionist policies, which strained Moscow's relations with Livonia.

zh.s: 1501年8月27日，利沃尼亚骑士团大团长沃尔特·冯·普莱滕贝格率军，与莫斯科大公国和普斯科夫共和国的军队交战。俄方惨败。俄罗斯大公伊凡三世推行扩张政策，使莫斯科与利沃尼亚的关系紧张。

en.s: The siege of Cannanore was a four-month siege, from 27 April 1507 to 27 August 1507, when troops of the local ruler (the Kōlattiri Raja of Cannanore), supported by the Zamorin of Calicut besieged the Portuguese garrison at St. Angelo Fort in Cannanore, in what is now the Indian state of Kerala. It followed the Battle of Cannanore, in which the fleet of the Zamorin was defeated by the Portuguese.

zh.s: 1507年4月27日至8月27日，当地统治者坎纳诺尔的科拉蒂里拉惹在科泽科德扎莫林支持下，围攻驻守于坎纳诺尔圣安杰洛堡的葡萄牙守军，围城持续四个月。此前，扎莫林舰队在坎纳诺尔战役中被葡萄牙人击败。

en.t: Pierre Barrière fails in an attempt to assassinate Henry IV of France
en.s: Pierre Barrière (died 31 August 1593) was a would-be assassin of King Henry IV of France. Barrière attempted an assassination of Henry IV on 27 August 1593. His assassination attempt failed when he was denounced by a Dominican priest to whom he had confessed. He was executed on 31 August 1593 by breaking on the wheel and dismemberment.

zh.t: 皮埃尔·巴里埃刺杀法国国王亨利四世未遂
zh.s: 皮埃尔·巴里埃（1593年8月31日去世）曾企图刺杀法国国王亨利四世。1593年8月27日，他试图行刺亨利四世，但他向一名多明我会修士忏悔后，被该修士告发，刺杀未遂。1593年8月31日，他被处以车轮刑并肢解。

en.s: The siege of Fushimi was a crucial battle in the series leading up to the decisive Battle of Sekigahara which ended Japan's Sengoku period. Fushimi Castle was defended by a force loyal to Tokugawa Ieyasu's Eastern army, led by Torii Mototada. Knowing of his inevitable defeat, Torii's sacrifice diverted Ishida Mitsunari's attention, and part of his Western army, away from his Nakasendō fortresses, which were attacked by Tokugawa during the siege of Fushimi.
en.n: Ishida Mitsunari's Western Army commences the Siege of Fushimi Castle, which is lightly defended by a much smaller Tokugawa garrison led by Torii Mototada.

zh.s: 伏见城围城战是通往决定性关原之战的一系列战斗中的关键一战；关原之战结束了日本战国时代。伏见城由效忠德川家康东军的部队守卫，守将为鸟居元忠。鸟居明知必败仍坚守，牵制了石田三成及其部分西军，使德川军得以在伏见围城战期间攻击石田在中山道沿线的堡垒。
zh.n: 石田三成的西军开始围攻伏见城，城中由鸟居元忠率领的德川守军兵力少得多，且防御薄弱。

en.s: The Battle of Lutter (Lutter am Barenberge) took place during the Thirty Years' War, on 27 August 1626 (17 August 1626 in the modern Gregorian calendar), between the forces of the Lower Saxon Circle, combining mostly Protestant states, and led by its Circle Colonel Christian IV of Denmark, and the forces of the Catholic League. Lutter am Barenberge lies to the south of the modern town of Salzgitter, then within the Imperial Circle of Lower Saxony, and now in northwest Germany. The battle resulted in a heavy defeat of Christian IV's troops by those of Emperor Ferdinand II, led by the Catholic League general Johan Tzerclaes, Count of Tilly.

zh.s: 卢特尔战役发生于1626年8月27日（按现代格里历为1626年8月17日），是三十年战争中的一场战斗。下萨克森帝国行政圈的军队主要由新教邦国组成，由行政圈统帅、丹麦国王克里斯蒂安四世率领；对手是天主教联盟军队。卢特尔位于今德国下萨克森州巴伦贝格卢特尔镇南侧。斐迪南二世皇帝麾下的天主教联盟军队在约翰·策克拉斯·冯·蒂利伯爵率领下击败了克里斯蒂安四世的部队。

en.s: The siege of Wolin, Wollin in Swedish sources: (Swedish: belägringen av Wollin) occurred from 21–27 August 1659 during the Second Northern War, as part of the Allied offensive into Swedish Pomerania. On 20 August, the Austrians landed on Wolin island, capturing two sconces at the mouth of the Dievenow, moving towards the city of Wolin soon after. They initially assaulted the city on 21 August, but were repelled.

zh.s: 第二次北方战争期间，1659年8月21日至27日，盟军进攻瑞典属波美拉尼亚，沃林围城战是其中一部分。8月20日，奥地利军队登陆沃林岛，攻占迪韦努夫河口的两座棱堡，随后向沃林城推进。8月21日，他们首次攻城，但遭到击退。瑞典语资料称此地为Wollin。

en.s: The siege of Nagyvárad in 1660 was initiated by the Ottomans, led by Szejdi Ahmed Pasha and Ali Pasha, against the Transylvanian fortress of Várad (modern-day Oradea) which was the most important fortress in Transylvania. The Ottomans successfully captured Várad after 44 days of siege.

zh.s: 1660年，塞伊迪·艾哈迈德帕夏和阿里帕夏率领奥斯曼军队，围攻特兰西瓦尼亚要塞瓦拉德（今罗马尼亚奥拉迪亚）。这是特兰西瓦尼亚最重要的堡垒。经过44天围城，奥斯曼军队成功攻占瓦拉德。

en.s: The siege of Kamieniec Podolski (Polish: Oblężenie Kamieńca Podolskiego; Turkish: Kamaniçe kuşatması) was laid by the Ottoman Empire on August 18, 1672, in the Polish fortress of Kamieniec Podolski (now: Kamianets-Podilskyi, Ukraine). It lasted until August 27, when Polish forces defending the city capitulated. During the siege, legendary Polish hero, stolnik przemyski pułkownik Jerzy Wołodyjowski led many successful sallies with light cavalry.

zh.s: 1672年8月18日，奥斯曼帝国开始围攻波兰要塞卡缅涅茨-波多尔斯基（今乌克兰卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基）。围城持续至8月27日，守城的波兰军队投降。围城期间，波兰传奇英雄、普热梅希尔桌官兼上校耶日·沃沃迪约夫斯基率轻骑兵多次成功出击。

en.s: The Treaty of Nerchinsk was a peace treaty signed between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing dynasty following Russia's defeat at the Siege of Albazin. Signed on 27 August 1689 by Songgotu on behalf of the Kangxi Emperor and Fyodor Golovin for Russian Tsars Peter I and Ivan V, it was the first formal treaty China ever signed with a Western power.

zh.s: 俄罗斯沙皇国在阿尔巴津围城战中战败后，与清朝签订了《尼布楚条约》。1689年8月27日，索额图代表康熙皇帝、费奥多尔·戈洛文代表俄罗斯沙皇彼得一世和伊凡五世签署条约。这是中国与西方国家签订的第一份正式条约。

en.s: The Battle of Valencia de Alcántara took place in August 1762 when an Anglo Portuguese force led by John Burgoyne surprised and captured the town of Valencia de Alcántara from its Spanish defenders during the Seven Years' War. The town was taken on 27 August as part of the defence against the Spanish invasion of Portugal. The force that captured Almeida was part of a significant Spanish offensive to overrun Portugal.

zh.t: 瓦伦西亚-德阿尔坎塔拉战役
zh.s: 七年战争期间，1762年8月，约翰·伯戈因率领的英葡联军突袭并从西班牙守军手中夺取瓦伦西亚-德阿尔坎塔拉镇。该镇于8月27日被攻下，这是抵御西班牙入侵葡萄牙的行动之一。攻占阿尔梅达的部队也参与了西班牙大规模攻占葡萄牙的攻势。

en.s: The raid on Saint John took place on 27 August 1775 during the American Revolutionary War. The raid involved American privateers from Machias, Massachusetts attacking Saint John, Nova Scotia on the northeast shore of the Bay of Fundy (in present day New Brunswick) Saint John and the rest of New Brunswick would later split from Nova Scotia.

zh.s: 1775年8月27日，美国独立战争期间，来自马萨诸塞州马基亚斯的美国私掠船袭击了新斯科舍省圣约翰。圣约翰位于芬迪湾东北岸，今属新不伦瑞克省；后来圣约翰及新不伦瑞克其他地区从新斯科舍省分离。

en.s: The Battle of Long Island, also known as the Battle of Brooklyn and the Battle of Brooklyn Heights, fought on August 27, 1776, was the first major battle of the American Revolutionary War to take place after the United States declared its independence on July 4, 1776. It was a victory for the British Army and the beginning of a successful campaign that gave them control of the strategically important city of New York. In terms of troop deployment and fighting, it was the largest battle of the entire war.

zh.s: 1776年8月27日，长岛战役（又称布鲁克林战役或布鲁克林高地战役）爆发。这是美国于同年7月4日宣布独立后，美国独立战争中的首场重大战役。英军获胜，并由此开始一场成功的战役，控制了具有重要战略意义的纽约市。无论参战兵力还是战斗规模，这都是整场战争中最大的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Pollilur was fought on 27 August 1781, between forces of the Kingdom of Mysore under Hyder Ali and British East India Company forces led by General Eyre Coote. The battle was fought on the site of a 1780 encounter in which a Company force was almost completely killed or captured. In the 1781 battle, the company's army was organized into 2 lines. One line fought against the troops under Tipu. But Hyder Ali's army faced severe casualties and retreated to Kanchipuram. After the battle a shortage of provisions led Coote to move his forces toward Tripasur.

zh.s: 1781年8月27日，海德尔·阿里率领的迈索尔王国军队与埃尔·库特将军指挥的英国东印度公司军队交战。战斗发生在1780年一场遭遇战的旧址；当时东印度公司一支部队几乎全军覆没或被俘。1781年这场战斗中，公司军队分成两列，其中一列与蒂普率领的部队交战。海德尔·阿里的军队伤亡惨重，撤退至甘吉布勒姆。战后，库特因补给短缺，率军向特里帕苏尔进发。

en.s: The Battle of Elizabethtown occurred on August 27, 1781 in Elizabethtown, North Carolina in Bladen County, North Carolina. The battle was fought between Patriot troops under the command of Thomas Robeson and Thomas Brown and the Loyalist North Carolina militia commanded by John Slingsby and David Godden. John Slingsby and David Godden were both mortally wounded and many of the soldiers fled the area into a ravine near the river, which has been known as "Tory Hole" ever since.

zh.s: 1781年8月27日，北卡罗来纳州布拉登县的伊丽莎白镇发生战斗。托马斯·罗伯森和托马斯·布朗率领的爱国派军队，与约翰·斯林斯比和大卫·戈登指挥的北卡罗来纳保王派民兵交战。斯林斯比和戈登均受致命伤，许多士兵逃入河边一处峡谷，此后该地被称为“保王派峡谷”。

en.s: The Battle of the Combahee River was a battle of the American Revolutionary War fought on August 27, 1782, near Beaufort, South Carolina, one of many such confrontations after the Siege of Yorktown to occur before the British evacuated Charleston in December 1782. Of note is the death of 27-year-old Colonel John Laurens, "one of the bravest and most gallant of the American officers."

zh.s: 1782年8月27日，美国独立战争期间，康巴希河战役在南卡罗来纳州博福特附近爆发。这是约克镇围城战后、英军于1782年12月撤离查尔斯顿前发生的多场交战之一。27岁的约翰·劳伦斯上校在战斗中阵亡，他被称为“美国军官中最勇敢、最英武的人之一”。

en.s: The Declaration of Pillnitz was a statement of five sentences issued on 27 August 1791 at Pillnitz Castle near Dresden (Saxony) by Frederick William II of Prussia and the Habsburg Leopold II, Holy Roman Emperor who was Marie Antoinette's brother. It declared the joint support of the Holy Roman Empire and of Prussia for King Louis XVI of France against the French Revolution.

zh.s: 1791年8月27日，普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉二世和哈布斯堡王朝的神圣罗马帝国皇帝利奥波德二世在萨克森州德累斯顿附近的皮尔尼茨城堡发布了一份由五句话组成的声明。利奥波德二世是玛丽·安托瓦内特的兄弟。宣言表示神圣罗马帝国和普鲁士共同支持法国国王路易十六，对抗法国大革命。

en.t: 1792–93 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1792–93 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between August 27, 1792, and September 6, 1793. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 3rd United States Congress convened on December 2, 1793.

zh.s: 1792年8月27日至1793年9月6日间，各州在不同日期举行1792—1793年美国众议院选举。各州自行确定众议院选举日期。第三届美国国会于1793年12月2日召开首次会议。

en.s: The siege of Mantua lasted from 4 June 1796 to 2 February 1797 with a short break where French forces under the overall command of Napoleon Bonaparte besieged and blockaded a large Austrian garrison at Mantua for many months until it surrendered. The siege was the focal point of the Italian Campaign of 1796-1797, lasting the vast majority of the campaign and being the hinge point that would determine which side would control Northern Italy.

zh.s: 曼图亚围城战从1796年6月4日持续到1797年2月2日，中间短暂中断过一次。拿破仑·波拿巴总指挥下的法军围困并封锁了曼图亚的一支奥地利大军，数月后守军投降。这场围城战是1796至1797年意大利战役的核心，持续时间占战役的大部分，也成为决定意大利北部由哪一方控制的关键战事。

en.s: The Battle of Castlebar occurred on 27 August 1798 near the town of Castlebar, County Mayo, during the Irish Rebellion of that year. A combined force of 2,000 French troops and Irish rebels routed a force of 6,000 British militia in what would later become known as the "Castlebar Races" or "Races of Castlebar".

zh.s: 1798年8月27日，爱尔兰起义期间，卡斯尔巴战役在梅奥郡卡斯尔巴镇附近爆发。由2000名法国士兵和爱尔兰起义军组成的联军击溃了6000名英国民兵，这场战斗后来被称为“卡斯尔巴大溃逃”。

en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority.
en.n: Wolfe Tone's United Irish and French forces clash with the British Army in the Battle of Castlebar, part of the Irish Rebellion of 1798, resulting in the creation of the French puppet Republic of Connacht.

zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义（爱尔兰语：Éirí Amach 1798；阿尔斯特苏格兰语称“The Turn Out”或“The Hurries”）是爱尔兰王国境内反抗英国王室的一场民众起义。当时的爱尔兰王国名义上独立，但从属于英国。主要组织者是联合爱尔兰人协会。该协会最初由贝尔法斯特的长老会信徒创立，他们反对土地由圣公会势力控制；在对改革失去信心后，协会转而寻求与爱尔兰天主教多数派联合，以革命方式建立共和国。
zh.n: 沃尔夫·托恩率领的联合爱尔兰人和法国军队在卡斯尔巴战役中与英军交战。这场战斗是1798年爱尔兰起义的一部分，并促成法国扶植的康诺特共和国成立。

en.s: The Battle of Callantsoog (also known as the Battle of Groote Keeten) (27 August 1799) was an amphibious landing by a British invasion force under Lieutenant-General Sir Ralph Abercromby and Admiral Lord Adam Duncan near Callantsoog during the Anglo-Russian invasion of Holland in 1799. Despite strong opposition by troops of the Batavian Republic under Lieutenant-General Herman Willem Daendels, the British established a bridgehead and the Batavians were forced to retreat.

en.t: Simon Winchester maintains, in his 2003 book Krakatoa: The Day the World Exploded: August 27, 1883, that the 1680 eruption was depicted in an eighteenth-century etching by Dutch cartographer Jan van Schley called Het Brandende Eiland, "The Burning Island", writing that "it was a depiction, without a doubt, of the otherwise little-chronicled eruption that supposedly took place in 1680."
en.s: Krakatoa (), also transcribed Krakatau (), is a caldera in the Sunda Strait between the islands of Java and Sumatra in the Indonesian province of Lampung. The caldera is part of a volcanic island group (Krakatoa archipelago) comprising four islands. Two of them are known as Lang and Verlaten; another, Rakata, is the only remnant of an island, also called Krakatoa, mostly destroyed by an eruption in 1883 which created the caldera.

zh.s: 喀拉喀托（也转写为Krakatau）是位于巽他海峡的一座火山口，处于印度尼西亚楠榜省爪哇岛与苏门答腊岛之间。火山口属于喀拉喀托群岛的一组火山岛，共有四座岛屿。其中两座名为朗岛和弗拉滕岛；另一座拉卡塔岛是原喀拉喀托岛仅存的部分。原岛大部分在1883年喷发中被毁，喷发形成了火山口。

en.s: The 1893 Sea Islands hurricane was a catastrophic and deadly Category 3 major hurricane that struck the Sea Islands near Savannah, Georgia on August 27, 1893. It was the 7th deadliest hurricane in United States history, and was one of three deadly hurricanes during the 1893 Atlantic hurricane season; the storm killed an estimated 1,000–2,000 people, mostly from storm surge that inundated the low-lying areas across the Southeastern United States in Georgia and South Carolina.

zh.s: 1893年8月27日，三级强飓风袭击了佐治亚州萨凡纳附近的海岛，造成重大灾害和人员伤亡。这是美国历史上死亡人数第七多的飓风，也是1893年大西洋飓风季中造成死亡的三场飓风之一。估计有1000至2000人遇难，多数死于风暴潮淹没美国东南部佐治亚州和南卡罗来纳州低洼地区。

en.s: The Battle of Baguashan (Chinese: 八卦山戰役), the largest battle ever fought on Taiwanese soil, was the pivotal battle of the Japanese invasion of Taiwan. The battle, fought on 27 August 1895 near the city of Changhua in central Taiwan between the invading Japanese army and the forces of the short-lived Republic of Formosa, was a decisive Japanese victory, and doomed the Republic of Formosa to early extinction. The battle was one of the few occasions on which the Formosans were able to deploy artillery against the Japanese.

zh.s: 八卦山战役（中文：八卦山戰役）是日本侵台战争中的关键战役，也是台湾岛上规模最大的一场战斗。1895年8月27日，日军与短暂存在的台湾民主国军队在台湾中部彰化附近交战。日军取得决定性胜利，使台湾民主国很快走向覆亡。这也是台湾民主国军队少数得以使用火炮对抗日军的战斗之一。

en.s: The Anglo-Zanzibar War was a military conflict fought between the United Kingdom and the Sultanate of Zanzibar on 27 August 1896. The immediate cause of the war was the suspicious death of the pro-British Sultan Hamad bin Thuwaini on 25 August 1896 and the subsequent succession of Sultan Khalid bin Barghash.

en.s: The Bug–Narew offensive from July 13 to August 27, 1915 was a major German victory during World War I on the Eastern Front. The Imperial German Army broke through 4 heavily fortified positions, inflicted defeats on superior enemy forces and pushed the Russian Army 300 km to the east, capturing 215,000 prisoners. But the German army also suffered relatively heavy casualties, about 30,000 killed and missing.

en.s: The Kingdom of Romania remained neutral throughout the first two years of World War I. They eventually entered the conflict on the side of the Entente from 27 August 1916 until insurmountable pressure from the Central Powers - which had occupied two thirds of the country - led to an armistice being signed on 9 December 1917. Six months later, a crippling peace treaty was imposed on Romania, which the government ratified.

en.s: The Warrenpoint ambush or Narrow Water ambush (also called the Warrenpoint massacre or Narrow Water massacre) was a guerrilla attack by the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 27 August 1979. The IRA's South Armagh Brigade ambushed the British Army with two large roadside bombs at Narrow Water Castle (near Warrenpoint) in Northern Ireland. The first bomb targeted a British Army convoy and the second targeted the reinforcements sent to deal with the incident. IRA volunteers hidden in nearby woodland also allegedly fired on the troops. The castle is on the banks of the Newry River, which marks the border between Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland.

zh.s: 1979年8月27日，临时派爱尔兰共和军（IRA）发动游击袭击，在北爱尔兰沃伦波因特附近的纳罗沃特城堡，以两枚大型路边炸弹伏击英军。第一枚炸弹袭击一支英军车队，第二枚针对前来处理事态的增援部队。附近树林中埋伏的IRA志愿者据称也向英军开火。城堡位于纽里河畔，该河标示北爱尔兰与爱尔兰共和国的边界。此事也称纳罗沃特伏击事件，或沃伦波因特大屠杀、纳罗沃特大屠杀。

en.s: The 1985 Nigerian coup d'état was a military coup which took place in Nigeria on 27 August 1985 when a faction of mid-level Armed Forces officers, led by the Chief of Army Staff Major-General Ibrahim Babangida, overthrew the government of Major General Muhammadu Buhari (who himself took power in the 1983 coup d'état). Buhari was then detained in Benin City until 1988.

en.s: STS-51-I was the 20th mission of NASA's Space Shuttle program and the sixth flight of Space Shuttle Discovery. During the mission, Discovery deployed three communications satellites into orbit. The mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on August 27, 1985, and landed at Edwards Air Force Base, California, on September 3, 1985.

en.s: SummerSlam (1990) was the third annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on August 27, 1990, at The Spectrum in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The card consisted of ten televised matches, including two main events. The Ultimate Warrior successfully defended his WWF World Heavyweight Championship against Rick Rude in a steel cage match, and Hulk Hogan defeated Earthquake by countout. The pay-per-view also included two other title matches. Mr. Perfect lost his WWF Intercontinental Championship to the Texas Tornado, who was a substitute for Brutus Beefcake, who had been injured in a real-life accident.

zh.s: 1990年8月27日，世界摔角联合会（WWF）在宾夕法尼亚州费城的Spectrum体育馆举办第三届年度夏日狂潮职业摔角付费赛事。赛事共转播10场比赛，其中包括两场主赛。终极战士在钢笼赛中击败瑞克·鲁德，成功卫冕WWF世界重量级冠军；胡克·霍根则凭借对手数秒不出场击败地震。赛事还包括另外两场冠军赛。布鲁图斯·比夫凯克因现实中的意外受伤，由得克萨斯旋风替补参赛；完美先生输掉WWF洲际冠军头衔。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 2808 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Mineralnye Vody to Ivanovo, both in Russia, with a stopover in Donetsk, Ukraine on 27 August 1992. While attempting to land at Ivanovo airport, the Tupolev Tu-134 crashed into a group of buildings in the village of Lebyazhy Lug. Investigators determined the cause of the accident was errors made by the crew and the air traffic controller.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空2808号班机空难
zh.s: 1992年8月27日，俄罗斯航空2808号定期国内客运航班从俄罗斯矿水城飞往伊万诺沃，中途停靠乌克兰顿涅茨克。飞机尝试降落伊万诺沃机场时，图-134客机撞上列比亚日卢格村的一组建筑。调查人员认定，事故原因是机组人员和空中交通管制员的操作失误。

en.s: In professional wrestling, the NWA World Title Tournament was a live supercard held by the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States-based professional wrestling promotion NWA Eastern Championship Wrestling on August 27, 1994. The event featured a tournament for the vacant NWA World Heavyweight Championship. The commentator for the event was Joey Styles. Highlights from the event aired on the August 29, 1994 episode of ECW Hardcore TV, while the tournament final appeared on the 2012 WWE DVD release ECW Unreleased: Vol 1. The event is known for the speech given by the tournament winner, ECW Heavyweight Champion Shane Douglas, who threw down the NWA World Heavyweight Championship and proclaimed the ECW Heavyweight Championship to be a world championship.

zh.s: 1994年8月27日，总部位于美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的NWA东部冠军摔角举办了一场职业摔角大型现场赛事，其中包括争夺空缺NWA世界重量级冠军的锦标赛。乔伊·斯泰尔斯担任赛事解说。赛事集锦于1994年8月29日播出的《ECW硬核电视》中播出，锦标赛决赛则收录于WWE 2012年发行的DVD《ECW未公开影像：第1卷》。这场赛事以锦标赛冠军、ECW重量级冠军谢恩·道格拉斯的演讲而闻名：他将NWA世界重量级冠军腰带摔在地上，并宣布ECW重量级冠军头衔也属于世界冠军。

en.s: The 1995 SummerSlam was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the eighth annual SummerSlam and took place on Sunday, August 27, 1995, at the Civic Arena in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. This was the first SummerSlam to broadcast live on a Sunday as all prior events were held on a Monday, except the 1992 event, which took place on a Saturday but aired on tape delay the following Monday.

en.s: SummerSlam (2000) was the thirteenth annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). The event was presented by Chef Boyardee and took place on August 27, 2000, at the Raleigh Entertainment and Sports Arena in Raleigh, North Carolina. The main event was a Triple Threat match for the WWF Championship involving champion The Rock, Triple H, and Kurt Angle. The Rock won the match and retained the title after pinning Triple H following a People's Elbow. One of the predominant matches on the undercard was Kane versus The Undertaker, which ended in a no contest after Undertaker unmasked Kane.

zh.s: 2000年8月27日，世界摔角联合会（WWF）在北卡罗来纳州罗利的罗利娱乐与体育馆举办第十三届年度夏日狂潮付费赛事，由Chef Boyardee赞助。主赛是WWF冠军三重威胁赛，冠军洛克、Triple H和科特·安格参赛。洛克使出“人民肘击”后压制Triple H获胜，成功卫冕。另一场重要比赛是凯恩对阵送葬者；送葬者揭开凯恩的面具后，比赛以无结果告终。

en.s: The 2004 UEFA Super Cup was an association football match between Porto of Portugal and Valencia of Spain on 27 August 2004, held at the Stade Louis II in Monaco. The match was the 29th annual UEFA Super Cup contested between the winners of the UEFA Champions League and UEFA Cup. Porto were appearing in the Super Cup for the third time; they won the competition in 1987 and lost in 2003. Valencia were appearing in the competition for the second time; their previous appearance in 1980 resulted in a victory. The teams had qualified for the Super Cup match by winning the two seasonal European competitions.

en.s: The insurgency in Paraguay, also known as the Paraguayan People's Army insurgency and the EPP rebellion (from the group's name in Spanish: Ejército del Pueblo Paraguayo), is an ongoing low-level armed conflict in northeastern Paraguay. en.s: The Kokang incident was a violent series of skirmishes that broke out in August 2009 in Kokang in Myanmar's northern Shan State. Several clashes between ethnic minorities and the Burmese military junta forces (including the Myanmar Armed Forces, also known as Tatmadaw, and the Myanmar Police Force) took place. As a result of the conflict, the MNDAA lost control of the area and as many as 30,000 refugees fled to Yunnan in neighbouring China.

en.s: The 2010 UEFA Super Cup was the 35th UEFA Super Cup, between the reigning champions of the two club competitions organised by the European football governing body UEFA: the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. en.s: The Singaporean presidential election of 2011 was the fourth Singaporean presidential election, held on 27 August 2011. Nomination Day for eligible candidates was held on 17 August 2011. S.R. Nathan, the previous President of Singapore, stepped down on 31 August 2011 when his term drew to a close. He could have sought re-election, as there is no term limit, but he declined to do so. Four candidates were issued certificates of eligibility by Singapore's Presidential Elections Committee, and all four were nominated on Nomination Day. This was the first contested election since the 1993 election and the first presidential race with more than two candidates in Singaporean history.

zh.s: 2011年8月27日，新加坡举行第四次总统选举。合格候选人的提名日为8月17日。前总统塞拉潘·纳丹于8月31日任期届满后卸任。虽然总统任期没有限制，他本可竞选连任，但决定不参选。总统选举委员会向4名候选人颁发资格证书，4人均在提名日正式登记。这是自1993年以来首次有竞争的总统选举，也是新加坡历史上首次有超过两名候选人参选的总统竞选。

en.s: Hurricane Irene was a large and destructive tropical cyclone which affected much of the Caribbean and East Coast of the United States during late August 2011. zh.n: 艾琳飓风袭击美国东海岸，造成47人死亡，估计损失156亿美元。

en.s: The 2013 Birmingham, Alabama mayoral election was held on August 27, 2013, to elect the mayor of Birmingham, Alabama. Incumbent Mayor William A. Bell, who was first elected in a 2010 special election and re-elected to a two-year term in 2011, ran for re-election to his first full term as mayor. He faced a little-known field of challengers and won re-election in a landslide, receiving 82 percent of the vote.

en.s: Prisión Fatal (2014) was a professional wrestling major event, produced by the Mexico based International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion. The event took on August 27, 2014, at "Arena Naucalpan" in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, IWRG's main venue and was the fourth show promoted under that name. The main event was the eponymous Prisión Fatal (Spanish for "Deadly Prison") Steel cage match where the last person remaining in the cage was forced to unmasked or shaved bald as per the match stipulation. The Prisión Fatal match included Alan Extreme, Chucho el Roto, Ciclon Black, Golden Magic, Metaleón, Relámpago, Tony Rivera and Yakuza.

zh.s: 2014年8月27日，总部位于墨西哥的国际摔角革命联盟（IWRG）在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的主场馆Arena Naucalpan举办大型职业摔角赛事“致命牢笼”。这是以该名称举办的第四场赛事。主赛是同名钢笼赛，按比赛规则，最后留在笼中的选手必须摘下面具或剃光头。参赛者包括Alan Extreme、Chucho el Roto、Ciclon Black、Golden Magic、Metaleón、Relámpago、Tony Rivera和Yakuza。

en.t: 1st Justice and Development Party Extraordinary Congress
en.s: The 2014 Extraordinary Congress of the Justice and Development Party (Turkish: Adalet ve Kalkınma Partisi Olağanüstü Kongresi) was held on 27 August 2014 in order to elect a new leader of the Justice and Development Party (often abbreviated AK Party or AKP), the ruling political party of Turkey. It was the first extraordinary congress in the party's history, necessitated by the election of party leader Recep Tayyip Erdoğan as the 12th president of Turkey.

en.s: The 2016 Northern Territory general election was held on Saturday 27 August 2016 to elect all 25 members of the Legislative Assembly in the unicameral Northern Territory Parliament. Legislation was passed in February 2016 to change the voting method of single-member electorates from full-preferential voting to optional preferential voting. Electoral districts were redistributed in 2015. The election was conducted by the Northern Territory Electoral Commission, an independent body answerable to Parliament.

en.s: The 2022–23 Premier League match between Liverpool and Bournemouth at Anfield, Liverpool, took place on Saturday 27 August 2022. Previously, the feat had been achieved on three occasions in the Premier League; twice by Manchester United in 1995 and 2021 against Ipswich Town and Southampton respectively, and once by Leicester City in 2019, also against Southampton.

en.s: The 2024 Tulsa mayoral election was held on August 27, 2024, and November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Tulsa, Oklahoma. Monroe Nichols won the runoff election, becoming the first Black Mayor of Tulsa. Since no candidate received over 50% of the vote in the August election, Tulsa County commissioner Karen Keith and Nichols advanced to a runoff scheduled for November 5, 2024.
